 ## Conditional Sections
 
-For `{{IF_CONDITION}}...{{END_IF_CONDITION}}` patterns:
+For `{{IF_CONDITION}}...{{END_IF_CONDITION}}` patterns.
+
+**Use the bundled `fill_template.py` — do not re-derive this.** Run it directly; it
+handles split-run placeholders, tables (incl. nested), headers/footers, single- AND
+multi-paragraph conditionals, and it VERIFIES that no `{{...}}` survive (exiting with
+an error if any do):
+
+```bash
+python3 fill_template.py template.docx data.json output.docx
+```
+
+Or import it: `from fill_template import fill_template; fill_template(tmpl, data_json, out)`.
+
+**Two bugs recur in hand-written conditional fillers — `fill_template.py` avoids both,
+and you MUST avoid them if you write your own:**
+
+1. **A kept block's inner placeholders must ALSO be replaced.** When `{{IF_X}}` is
+   included, every `{{KEY}}` between the markers still needs its value substituted.
+   Leaving them raw is the most common failure (e.g. an offer letter that keeps the
+   relocation clause but prints a literal `{{RELOCATION_AMOUNT}}`).
+2. **The gate key is often NOT the tag name.** `{{IF_RELOCATION}}` may be gated by a
+   data field named `RELOCATION_PACKAGE` (= "Yes"/"No"), not `RELOCATION`. Look up the
+   include/exclude decision by exact key first, then by any data key that contains the
+   tag as a token; treat yes/true/1/y as include and no/false/0/n/none/"" as exclude.
+   Defaulting to INCLUDE when no gating field is found is safer than silently deleting a
+   real section.
+
+Blocks also frequently **span multiple paragraphs** (`{{IF_X}}` on one line, content in
+following paragraphs, `{{END_IF_X}}` later) — a single-paragraph-only scan misses these.
+`fill_template.py` tracks an include-stack across paragraphs to handle them.
+
+The naive single-paragraph shape below works ONLY when the whole block is on one line
+and the gate key equals the tag; prefer `fill_template.py` in general:
 
 ```python
 def handle_conditional(doc, condition_key, should_include, data):
-    """Remove or keep conditional sections."""
+    """Single-line {{IF_X}}...{{END_IF_X}} only. See fill_template.py for the general case."""
     start_marker = '{{IF_' + condition_key + '}}'
     end_marker = '{{END_IF_' + condition_key + '}}'

 ## Complete Solution Pattern
+
+**Note:** the routine below fills plain `{{KEY}}` placeholders but does NOT handle
+`{{IF_X}}...{{END_IF_X}}` conditionals — if the template has any conditional sections,
+use `fill_template.py` (above) instead, which does both and then verifies nothing is left
+unresolved.
 
 ```python

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Fill a Word ``{{PLACEHOLDER}}`` template from a JSON data file — correctly.
+
+Use this instead of re-deriving your own routine: the two recurring bugs in
+hand-written template fillers are (1) leaving inner placeholders un-replaced
+inside a kept conditional block, and (2) gating a conditional on the wrong key.
+This script avoids both and verifies no ``{{...}}`` survive.
+
+    python fill_template.py template.docx data.json output.docx
+
+Handles: split-run placeholders (rebuilt at paragraph level), tables incl.
+nested, headers/footers, and ``{{IF_X}}...{{END_IF_X}}`` conditionals that may
+span multiple paragraphs.
+
+Conditional gating — READ THIS
+------------------------------
+For a marker ``{{IF_RELOCATION}}``, the include/exclude decision comes from a
+SEPARATE data lookup, and the data key is often NOT literally ``RELOCATION``
+(e.g. it is ``RELOCATION_PACKAGE`` = "Yes"). ``_should_include`` therefore:
+  * checks an exact key match on the tag name first, then
+  * any data key that contains the tag name as a token (RELOCATION_PACKAGE),
+  * treats yes/true/1/y/included/enabled (case-insensitive) as include,
+    and no/false/0/n/none/excluded/disabled as exclude,
+  * defaults to INCLUDE when no gating field is found (keeping real content and
+    filling its placeholders is safer than silently deleting a section).
+When a block is KEPT, its inner placeholders are ALWAYS replaced. When removed,
+the whole block (markers + content) is cleared.
+"""
+
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+
+PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}")
+IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{IF_([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}")
+END_IF_RE = re.compile(r"\{\{END_IF_([A-Z0-9_]+)\}\}")
+
+_TRUE = {"yes", "true", "1", "y", "include", "included", "enabled", "on"}
+_FALSE = {"no", "false", "0", "n", "none", "", "excluded", "disabled", "off"}
+
+
+def _should_include(data, tag):
+    """Decide whether an {{IF_<tag>}} block is kept, from a separate data lookup."""
+    def truthy(v):
+        s = str(v).strip().lower()
+        if s in _TRUE:
+            return True
+        if s in _FALSE:
+            return False
+        return bool(s)  # any other non-empty value counts as present/include
+
+    if tag in data:
+        return truthy(data[tag])
+    # tag may be gated by a differently-named key that contains it, e.g.
+    # IF_RELOCATION gated by RELOCATION_PACKAGE.
+    for key in data:
+        if tag in key.split("_") or tag in key:
«redacted»            return truthy(data[key])
+    return True  # no gating field found -> keep content, fill its placeholders
+
+
+def _replace_text(text, data):
+    """Replace every {{KEY}} in text that has a value in data."""
+    def sub(m):
+        key = «redacted»
+        return str(data[key]) if key in data else m.group(0)
+    return PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(sub, text)
+
+
+def _set_paragraph_text(para, new_text):
+    """Put new_text into the paragraph, preserving the first run's formatting."""
+    if para.runs:
+        para.runs[0].text = new_text
+        for run in para.runs[1:]:
+            run.text = ""
+    elif new_text:
+        para.add_run(new_text)
+
+
+def _process_paragraphs(paragraphs, data):
+    """Handle conditionals (possibly multi-paragraph) then fill placeholders."""
+    paras = list(paragraphs)
+    i = 0
+    include_stack = []  # active IF decisions
+    while i < len(paras):
+        para = paras[i]
+        text = para.text
+
+        start = IF_RE.search(text)
+        end = END_IF_RE.search(text)
+
+        # Single-paragraph block: {{IF_X}} ... {{END_IF_X}} on one line.
+        if start and end and end.start() > start.start():
+            tag = start.group(1)
+            keep = _should_include(data, tag)
+            if keep:
+                inner = text[start.end():end.start()]
+                _set_paragraph_text(para, _replace_text(inner, data))
+            else:
+                _set_paragraph_text(para, "")
+            i += 1
+            continue
+
+        # Opening a multi-paragraph block.
+        if start and not end:
+            tag = start.group(1)
+            keep = _should_include(data, tag)
+            include_stack.append(keep)
+            # strip just the marker; keep any trailing text on this line
+            residual = _replace_text(text[start.end():], data) if keep else ""
+            _set_paragraph_text(para, residual)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+
+        # Closing a multi-paragraph block.
+        if end and not start:
+            keep = include_stack.pop() if include_stack else True
+            residual = _replace_text(text[:end.start()], data) if keep else ""
+            _set_paragraph_text(para, residual)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+
+        # Ordinary paragraph.
+        active_keep = all(include_stack) if include_stack else T
